description: This file defines the LeaveBalanceAPI class, an API endpoint for retrieving leave balance information for employees within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It handles fetching leave balances for specific leave types, considering date ranges, employee details, and leave periods, and includes methods for processing leave data and formatting the response.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Leave\Api\LeaveBalanceAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for retrieving leave balance details for employees, supporting various query parameters and internal processing to generate detailed leave breakdowns.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles the GET request to retrieve the leave balance for a specific leave type, employee, and date range, returning normalized leave balance data along with employee and leave type metadata.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches leave type information as a normalized array for a given leave type ID.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveBalanceResult
methods.description: Processes leave periods and days to compute and normalize leave balance breakdowns, flagging negative balances.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdownForAppliedDateRange
methods.description: Generates a detailed breakdown of leave days and periods within a specified date range for an employee's leave type.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period for an employee given a date, using the leave entitlement strategy.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET operation, making 'to' and 'from' date parameters optional and allowing for employee access validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; this endpoint does not support updates.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; update validation is not supported.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; delete validation is not supported.
